title: Usable observations per month, catchment only (coverage_summary 1.0.0)
description: Precomputed result of recipe coverage_summary 1.0.0 on bundle_s2_ndvi_monthly_ait_bouguemez, for the catchment only (no strata in this version): 68 available, 16 insufficient, 0 missing periods. Reduced QA (scene classification only): snow, snow edges and terrain shadow can survive the mask. Coverage counts how much data passed the mask; it says nothing about vegetation condition. In winter months the accepted pixels favour the valley floor and south-facing slopes, because snow and shade remove the others; the area value then describes those pixels, not the whole catchment. This version summarizes the catchment only; per-stratum coverage is not computed yet.

providers.name: Siterra science pipeline
providers.processing:lineage: Deduplicated tile-date items (newest baseline), DN/10000 without offset, scene classification classes 4 and 5 kept, NDVI per observation, same-date tiles merged, per-pixel monthly median and date count, acceptance policy, area summaries over the frozen catchment (docs/reference/observation-preprocessing.md).

coverage_summary.title: Per-period dates, accepted share, cloud and snow shares

siterra:dataset.access_route: Earth Search STAC API https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/, collection sentinel-2-l2a (legacy), COGs on sentinel-cogs.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com read by window

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32629

operation_order: clear(p, d) = 1 if the scene classification of pixel p on date d is 4 (vegetation) or 5 (not vegetated) and red and near-infrared are present, else 0
dates(p, t) = number of distinct dates d in month t with clear(p, d) = 1
accepted(p, t) = 1 if dates(p, t) >= 3, else 0
valid_fraction(t) = sum over catchment pixels of accepted(p, t) / number of catchment pixels
status(t) = available if valid_fraction(t) >= 0.70; insufficient if below; missing if no clear date
